§ 02

The method

Strategy first. Posting second.

Most businesses post and hope for the best. We do the homework first, and it shows.

  1. 01

    Study the market

    We look at who else is in your space, what they post, what people save and share, and what nobody is doing yet. That gap is where you stand out.

  2. 02

    Understand your people

    Who buys from you? What do they ask? What words do they use? We read comments, reviews and questions, so your posts sound like them and not like an ad.

  3. 03

    Make a real plan

    Three or four themes, the right formats and a posting rhythm you can actually keep. Goals are enquiries and bookings, not just likes.

  4. 04

    Build a community

    We reply, start conversations, team up with local creators and give your customers a reason to tag you. The aim is simple: people talking about your business without being asked.

  5. 05

    Check and adjust

    Every month we show you what worked and what didn’t, in plain English. Then we do more of the first and less of the second.

§ 06

About us

Hi. We’re Spellbind Socials.

We’re a small social media agency in Pune. We work with small businesses, founders and creators who have something good to offer and a very quiet Instagram.

We got tired of watching businesses post at random and wonder why nothing happens. So we do it differently. Research first, then a real plan, then posting, then actually talking to people. It’s slower than chasing trends, and a lot more reliable.

Our mascot, Spellbind, is a black cat with strong opinions. She reviews everything we make and has never once been impressed. The swan in our logo is us: calm on the surface, a lot of paddling underneath.
